slides.2.componentProps.slide.title: 📋 Level 1 Assessment
Naoussa is Xinomavro's core; Nemea is Agiorgitiko, Santorini Assyrtiko, Mantineia Moschofilero.
It keeps high acidity even at full ripeness, with clear minerality.
Santorini vineyards need no grafted rootstocks because…
A. volcanic pumice and ash soils are phylloxera-free
C. the climate is too cold
This is one of Santorini's notable features.
Why choose high altitude in a hot climate?
Cool nights at altitude help preserve acidity.
Thrace and Central Greece have no PDOs and use PGIs.
Roughly how many PDOs and PGIs does Greece have?
PGIs far outnumber PDOs; check the latest official list before citing.
Which pink-skinned grape made as white grows in Mantinia?
Moschofilero has intense floral aromas and vibrant acidity.
A sweet wine famed in the Middle Ages from which place is the source of the name Malvasia?
The name Malvasia derives from Monemvasia.
